title: add-default-detail-to-feedback-not-configured-error
request: Can we make FeedbackNotConfiguredError include a helpful default message? I'd like it to set a body with a 'detail' field saying "Feedback is not configured" and allow overriding it.
reference_diff:
--- a/langfuse/api/feedback/errors/feedback_not_configured_error.py
+++ b/langfuse/api/feedback/errors/feedback_not_configured_error.py
@@ -6,8 +6,11 @@
 
 
 class FeedbackNotConfiguredError(ApiError):
-    def __init__(self, headers: typing.Optional[typing.Dict[str, str]] = None):
+    def __init__(self, headers: typing.Optional[typing.Dict[str, str]] = None, detail: typing.Optional[str] = None):
+        # Provide a default, user‑readable error body if none is supplied.
+        default_detail = "Feedback is not configured"
         super().__init__(
             status_code=409,
             headers=headers,
+            body={"detail": detail if detail is not None else default_detail},
         )

@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import typing
+
+import pytest
+
+from langfuse.api.feedback.errors.feedback_not_configured_error import FeedbackNotConfiguredError
+
+
+def test_feedback_not_configured_error_default_message():
+    err = FeedbackNotConfiguredError()
+    # The error should have a body dict with a default detail message.
+    assert isinstance(err.body, dict)
+    assert err.body.get("detail") == "Feedback is not configured"
+
+
+def test_feedback_not_configured_error_custom_message():
+    custom_msg = "Custom feedback error"
+    err = FeedbackNotConfiguredError(detail=custom_msg)
+    assert err.body.get("detail") == custom_msg
